findings.claim: The executed predicate drops TerminalStatus from the land-ready wait rule, so a pending record with a startedAt now ends the land-ready wait and cuts person waits while still pending.
findings.evidence: Base budget.go:498 was status == running || (TerminalStatus(status) && startedAt != ""). The diff has executed := status == running || startedAt != "" (budget.go:433), used at :502. BuildRecord and BuildFollowRecord write status pending with startedAt nowISO() (build.go:562/603, :909/:946), and adoption.go:119 re-pends a record. The effect is transient and errs toward counting time. T7b's fixture has no startedAt.

findings.claim: PersonWords prints %.1fh ("8.0h") where the lane words print %gh after rounding ("8h").
findings.change: Format the hours as the lane words do: %g of math.Round(minutes/6)/10.

findings.claim: No-close-time problems are emitted before the claim-window clip, and unreadable records add a problem to every goal's projection, so these lines are permanent on a re-claim.
findings.evidence: In the real ui records, a-done-goals-branch-is-swept has 3 closed questions with no times and the-second-half-is-the-seats has 6. No unreadable records exist in ui, m1e or main. This is in-spec per T4.
findings.change: None required; optionally skip a no-close-time problem for a question opened before from.

findings.claim: The local struct decodes only the fields it needs, so a record WalkQuestions refuses for a malformed unrelated field is read here and can pause the clock.
findings.evidence: WalkQuestions unmarshals the full channel.Question (question.go:226). personWaits unmarshals a narrow struct. No such record exists today.

findings.claim: TestPersonWaitReplyIsNotTheAct writes a plain question into the first root after its last assertion on that root; nothing reads it.
findings.evidence: budget_person_wait_channel_test.go lines 444-446. The comparison uses plainRoot.
findings.change: Drop the saveWaitQuestion(t, root, q) call at line 446.
